def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 3]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    markers = [(r, c) for r, c in points if r0 < r < r1 and c0 < c < c1]
    mr, mc = markers[0]
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        for c in range(c0 + 1, c1):
            if grid[r][c] == 3:
                out[r][c] = 3
            else:
                d = max(abs(r - mr), abs(c - mc))
                out[r][c] = 2 if d % 2 == 0 else 4
    return out

def make_case(marker):

    for r in range(2,11): g[r][3]=g[r][11]=3
    rr,cc=marker; g[rr][cc]=3
    return g
